value.rationale: It classifies a natural time-order fourth moment for all lags, gives strict positivity throughout signed contractions, and isolates a sharp overshoot-induced direction reversal and a time-irreversible fourth-order blind point. Covariance agreement with a Gaussian reversible comparator makes the contrast scientifically discriminative. No finite-sample estimation or general renewal law is claimed.
